Put here your Irem M92 games as MAME romsets, one .zip each, with the
names MAME uses (uccops.zip, hook.zip, bmaster.zip, mysticri.zip,
inthunt.zip ...). A clone also needs its parent's zip (for example
uccopsj.zip needs uccops.zip). ROMs are found by their CRC, so older
sets with other file names work too.

m92-pi creates here: saves/ (save states, DIP switches), shots/
(screenshots), m92pi.cfg, pads.cfg and LOG.TXT.
